$note: 官祿宮（2026-10-12）：天同巨門.官祿。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 官祿宮 p.530–560。殉職、牢獄、官非、血光、貪墨、意外一類斷語不用；天刑、天月、天巫、龍池鳳閣、三台八座等引擎冇嘅星不用；天機見 tianji-guanlu.json（試點）。

rules.text: 天同巨門見〔煞忌〕，你的事業反而要經歷艱難，然後成就大業。
rules.en: Tian Tong–Ju Men meets 〔harsh stars or Obstruction〕: your career goes through hardship, and that is how you build something great.

rules.text: 天同巨門在官祿宮，事業容易半途而廢；要選本質就要勞心的工作，才有成就。
rules.en: With Tian Tong and Ju Men in your Career Palace, ventures are easily dropped halfway; choose work that demands mental effort by its very nature, and you will get somewhere.
